svg.title: Compare retained dollars per settled call
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-retained-yield-comparison; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare retained dollars per settled call; subtitle: Five illustrative sub-niche yields use the same 55% retained-share assumption.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Bar lengths measure retained dollars per settled call before fulfillment, pod labor, and fixed overhead. Gross call prices are illustrative contract inputs, not observed market quotes. These alternatives are not an additive portfolio and do not alter the Base-Case blended $250 gross settlement assumption.; caption: Higher nominal yield can conceal longer collection cycles, tighter statutory restrictions, or worse rejection rates. Compare realized contribution per acquired inquiry before reallocating spend.; stages: label: Emergency plumbing dispatch; value: $110 retained from a $200 settled call; numeric value: 110.0; detail: $200 × 55% = $110 before remaining costs. Require live service-area coverage, a working dispatch endpoint, and documented buyer acceptance; an unanswered emergency transfer cannot be counted as a completed job.; label: Personal insurance inquiry; value: $137.50 retained from a $250 settled call; numeric value: 137.5; detail: $250 × 55% = $137.50 before remaining costs. Match state and product eligibility to the licensed buyer; record recipient-specific permission where required and reject duplicates under the signed lookback window.; label: Commercial insurance inquiry; value: $165 retained from a $300 settled call; numeric value: 165.0; detail: $300 × 55% = $165 before remaining costs. Capture business class and coverage intent without collecting unnecessary sensitive information; reconcile buyer staffing hours and acceptance criteria before buying traffic.; label: Water-restoration dispatch; value: $192.50 retained from a $350 settled call; numeric value: 192.5; detail: $350 × 55% = $192.50 before remaining costs. Verify incident location, actual dispatch availability, and service intent; do not equate the call price with restoration contract value or insurance proceeds.; label: Permitted legal advertising inquiry; value: $220 retained from a $400 settled call; numeric value: 220.0; detail: $400 × 55% = $220 before remaining costs. Activate only where the precise advertising arrangement is permitted under applicable state rules; check California Rules of Professional Conduct 7.2 and Business and Professions Code sections 6151–6153 for relevant California activity. A fixed call price alone does not establish permissibility.

rect.title: label: Emergency plumbing dispatch; value: $110 retained from a $200 settled call; numeric value: 110.0; detail: $200 × 55% = $110 before remaining costs. Require live service-area coverage, a working dispatch endpoint, and documented buyer acceptance; an unanswered emergency transfer cannot be counted as a completed job.

label: Personal insurance inquiry; value: $137.50 retained from a $250 settled call; numeric value: 137.5; detail: $250 × 55% = $137.50 before remaining costs. Match state and product eligibility to the licensed buyer; record recipient-specific permission where required and reject duplicates under the signed lookback window.

label: Commercial insurance inquiry; value: $165 retained from a $300 settled call; numeric value: 165.0; detail: $300 × 55% = $165 before remaining costs. Capture business class and coverage intent without collecting unnecessary sensitive information; reconcile buyer staffing hours and acceptance criteria before buying traffic.

label: Water-restoration dispatch; value: $192.50 retained from a $350 settled call; numeric value: 192.5; detail: $350 × 55% = $192.50 before remaining costs. Verify incident location, actual dispatch availability, and service intent; do not equate the call price with restoration contract value or insurance proceeds.

label: Permitted legal advertising inquiry; value: $220 retained from a $400 settled call; numeric value: 220.0; detail: $400 × 55% = $220 before remaining costs. Activate only where the precise advertising arrangement is permitted under applicable state rules; check California Rules of Professional Conduct 7.2 and Business and Professions Code sections 6151–6153 for relevant California activity. A fixed call price alone does not establish permissibility.

text.title: Assumptions: Bar lengths measure retained dollars per settled call before fulfillment, pod labor, and fixed overhead. Gross call prices are illustrative contract inputs, not observed market quotes. These alternatives are not an additive portfolio and do not alter the Base-Case blended $250 gross settlement assumption.
